description: This file defines the ResourceGroupsTaggingAPIClient class which extends AwsClient and provides method signatures for interacting with the AWS Resource Groups Tagging API, including methods for describing report creation, getting compliance summaries, managing tags, and starting report creation.

classes.name: ResourceGroupsTaggingAPIClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the AWS Resource Groups Tagging API, extending AwsClient, with methods for managing resource tags and reports.

methods.name: describeReportCreation
methods.description: Retrieves the status of report creation.

methods.name: describeReportCreationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the status of report creation.

methods.name: getComplianceSummary
methods.description: Gets a summary of compliance results.

methods.name: getResourcesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches resources based on tags.

methods.name: getTagValues
methods.description: Retrieves all values for a specified tag key.

methods.name: getTagValuesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves all values for a tag key.

methods.name: startReportCreation
methods.description: Begins the creation of a report.

methods.name: tagResources
methods.description: Adds or updates tags for resources.
